keyboardAndFocus.method: DOM-order review of enabled native interactive controls plus source verification of the global focus-visible rule

contrast.method: bounded computed foreground/background review of visible headings, paragraphs, labels and controls

scalableText.method: 390 CSS-pixel responsive layout, equivalent to the layout width exposed by 200% zoom on a 780-pixel viewport

reducedMotion.contract: prefers-reduced-motion collapses animation and transition duration to 0.01ms and disables smooth scrolling
